title: Celosiae Semen and Celosin I alleviate postmenopausal osteoporosis by inhibiting ferroptosis through the Nrf2/GPX4 pathway.
authors: Jin, Zhuoru; Wei, Yufei; Zhou, Zimo; Fan, Zheng; Sun, Ning; Huang, Ying; Liu, Da
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药鸡冠花种子及其皂苷通过Nrf2/GPX4通路抑制铁死亡治疗绝经后骨质疏松，核心为细胞铁死亡与骨代谢，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且方法以实验和网络药理学为主，无AI或物理模拟建模。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Postmenopausal osteoporosis (PMOP) is characterized by bone loss and high fracture risk, with emerging evidence implicating ferroptosis in its pathogenesis. Celosiae Semen (CS) strengthens bones and contains saponins that may reduce ferroptosis, but the mechanisms are not well understood. PURPOSE: To determine whether total saponins of CS (TSCS) attenuate PMOP through the Nrf2/GPX4 pathway and whether Celosin I (CI) reproduces TSCS's core therapeutic effects. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Network pharmacology identified CS-related targets and pathways in osteoporosis. TSCS components were analyzed by HPLC. In vivo, ovariectomized (OVX) mice received TSCS or CI for 12 weeks, and bone microarchitecture was assessed by micro-CT. In vitro, tert‑butyl hydroperoxide (t-BHP) induced ferroptosis in bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs), followed by TSCS or CI treatment. Ferroptosis markers, mitochondrial function, and osteogenesis were evaluated via biochemical assays and Western blot. Molecular docking assessed compound-target interactions. Nrf2 knockout models were used to validate pathway dependence. RESULTS: TSCS significantly alleviated OVX-induced bone loss, improving bone mineral density and trabecular structure. It reduced lipid peroxidation, restored glutathione levels, and upregulated Nrf2 and GPX4. CI reproduced TSCS's anti-ferroptotic and pro-osteogenic effects in vivo and in vitro and showed strong binding affinity for Nrf2 and GPX4. Importantly, the protective effects of both TSCS and CI were markedly diminished in Nrf2-deficient models, confirming dependence on the Nrf2/GPX4 axis. CONCLUSIONS: TSCS mitigates PMOP progression by suppressing ferroptosis via Nrf2/GPX4 activation. CI replicates TSCS's therapeutic benefits, identifying both as promising candidates for targeting ferroptosis in osteoporosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：绝经后骨质疏松症（PMOP）以骨丢失和高骨折风险为特征，新近证据提示铁死亡（ferroptosis）参与其发病机制。青葙子（Celosiae Semen, CS）具有强骨作用，且含有可能减少铁死亡的皂苷类成分，但其机制尚不明确。目的：探讨青葙子总皂苷（total saponins of CS, TSCS）是否通过Nrf2/GPX4通路减轻PMOP，以及青葙子苷I（Celosin I, CI）是否能再现TSCS的核心治疗效应。研究设计与方法：通过网络药理学鉴定CS在骨质疏松症中的相关靶点和通路。采用高效液相色谱（HPLC）分析TSCS成分。体内实验中，去卵巢（OVX）小鼠接受TSCS或CI治疗12周，并通过micro-CT评估骨微结构。体外实验中，叔丁基过氧化氢（tert‑butyl hydroperoxide, t-BHP）诱导骨髓间充质干细胞（bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells, BMSCs）铁死亡，随后给予TSCS或CI处理。通过生化检测和Western blot评估铁死亡标志物、线粒体功能和成骨分化。分子对接评估化合物-靶点相互作用。使用Nrf2敲除模型验证通路依赖性。结果：TSCS显著减轻OVX诱导的骨丢失，改善骨密度和骨小梁结构。其降低脂质过氧化、恢复谷胱甘肽水平，并上调Nrf2和GPX4表达。CI在体内和体外均再现了TSCS的抗铁死亡和促成骨效应，并显示出对Nrf2和GPX4的强结合亲和力。重要的是，在Nrf2缺陷模型中，TSCS和CI的保护效应均显著减弱，证实其依赖Nrf2/GPX4轴。结论：TSCS通过激活Nrf2/GPX4抑制铁死亡，从而缓解PMOP进展。CI可复制TSCS的治疗益处，二者均被视为靶向铁死亡治疗骨质疏松症的有前景候选药物。
